obernants.domain: Declared bounded API inputs, states and finite fixtures

obernants.operator: For terminating finite harness executions, reports that disagree with the conjunction of assertions are excluded. Passing a candidate with any fixture mismatch is absent from the specified relation. Abort/nontermination are outside the observation universe; this relation is not a universal production correctness proof.
